name: auth
title: Auth page
description: The shell for sign-in, sign-up, forgot-password and invite pages: brand, a centred form column, a minimal footer. Optionally a split layout with a brand panel.

frame.summary: No TopNav nav items, no rail: brand mark, the form, legal links. The split variant adds a decorative panel at wide widths only.

regions.name: aside
regions.collapse: Hidden below wide; never stacked above the form.

components.name: visually-hidden
components.for: Skip link (optional — the form is the first content).

dependsOnFuture.for: Brand and legal links, and via sign-in/sign-up.

behavior.summary: A deliberately empty shell: the only thing on the page is the task.

decisions.why: TopNav's own decision: no destinations means no nav. Product navigation is unusable before sign-in.

decisions.decision: The form column is Dialog sm's width (control-lg × 10)
decisions.why: Reuses an existing derived width instead of a new one.

decisions.decision: The split panel is decorative and hidden when narrow
decisions.why: Stacking a brand panel above the form pushes the task below the fold on phones.

decisions.decision: The form column is on theme.bg.surface only when the page background is not
decisions.why: One surface step for separation; a Card around a form that is the whole page adds an edge for nothing.

landmarks.label: implicit; target of the skip link

obligations: Focus is not auto-moved into the email field on load — the h1 and any error read first; autofocus only on dedicated single-purpose pages after review.

steps.change: Single column, form fills less gutter.
Centred column, or split with the brand panel.

native.mapping: A full-screen modal flow presented before the main tab structure; brand at top, form, legal links at the bottom.
native.ios: fullScreenCover with NavigationStack for sign-in → forgot password.
native.android: Separate auth navigation graph shown before the main graph.

tokenGaps.need: Named breakpoints (narrow/medium/wide) as tokens or documented constants
tokenGaps.interim: The block is intrinsic (auto-fill grid, flex-wrap) and needs none. Where a step is unavoidable the page owns the query, as the playground owns its single 60rem NARROW query in use-media-query.ts.

openQuestions: Is a surfaced form column a Card (future) or a plain surface? Using Card would make the auth page blocked on it; this spec says plain surface.
